previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: Private output boundaries accept parent traversal and unchecked artifact names
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: A directory such as isolated_home/../outside/new, a symlinked earlier ancestor, or an absolute/../ artifact name is supplied.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: Path.is_relative_to is lexical and accepts '..'; checking only directory.parent.is_symlink does not establish ancestor custody. ObservationPages.write joins an unchecked name, which may replace the directory prefix or escape it. The declared private write scope is therefore not enforced before mkdir/open.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Validate canonical isolated home and every directory ancestor, reject '..'/aliases before effects, use retained directory ownership/custody and relative dir_fd operations, and restrict leaf names to one fixed safe component. Do not repin a changed directory as the expected owner.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Own trusted pathlib pure-data counterexample saved; no target directory or candidate writer executed.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: Canonical path rejects traversal/aliases before effects; complete trusted nonwritable ancestor chain retained as dir_fds/original identities; source shared capacity; fixed one-component safe leaves, O_NOFOLLOW, exact new-child custody; changed ownership never repinned.
